title: REJECT commits: the run is rejected with the reason, a REVISION successor run is minted, approval decisions carry a verdict
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-6061e05cd17540a1bbe08b965da58b64 (leaf; no sibling dependency). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the durable REJECT decision and the record that lets everything downstream find the goal's CURRENT run. No offer-ladder, compiler, wrapper or UI change (children 2-3).

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts (244 lines): DECISIONS = ["APPROVE","REJECT"] at :91; the intent shape {decision, decisionReason: string|null, dependencyChanges, runId} (:116-137); the only REJECT handling is `if (intent.decision !== "APPROVE") return refuse(null, "BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID", "DAEMON_PREREQUISITE")` at :196-198 BEFORE the fences/sources/human-review witness (:200-243) - pinned by approval-intent.test.ts:1273-1280 and :1565-1567 (both re-aimed by this row). APPROVE runs: source fences (:202-207), `readApprovalIntentSources` (:212), the HUMAN_APPROVED witness `input.humanReview` + operatorReviewAuthority (:218-231), then `commitIntentActivation` (:243, approval-intent-activation.ts). The file is at 244 lines: the REJECT commit goes in a NEW module `approval-intent-rejection.ts` (+ .js bridge), approval-intent.ts only branches to it after the SAME witness/fence checks (a REJECT is a human decision exactly like APPROVE).
- Core designed path: packages/core/src/planning/planning-results.ts:132 `rejectRun(state, commandId, findingsRef, successorRunId)` -> run lifecycle REJECTED (+ successorRunId on the event, :141-146) and returns `successor` = a DRAFT state for `successorRunId` (successorData :118-130; INITIAL/REVISION share the carrier). Run lifecycles: packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:49-50 (DRAFT, READY, PLANNING, SUBMISSION_DRAINING, PLAN_REVIEW, APPROVED, ACTIVATED, REJECTED, CANCELLED). `planning.create_draft` with `runKind: "REVISION"` needs only {goalRef, runId, runKind} (planning-command-contract.ts:160-167). Multi-aggregate commits ride one `commitExpectedVersionDecisionLegs` (see apps/daemon/src/planning/graph-activation-service.ts:41).
- The goal's run: the durable goal state carries ONE immutable `planningRunRef` (read at apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:88); `planReviewable(ledger, runId)` (:78-81) keys on the run lifecycle. Nothing today follows a REJECTED run to its successor.
- Activity: apps/daemon/src/http/activity-read.ts:77 VERDICT_KINDS = {escalation.decide, review.submit}; `verdictOf(commandKind, resultBytes)` (:80) reads the committed result; apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-words.ts:69 ALREADY renders "approved the plan" / "rejected the plan" for an approval verdict - the server never emits one.

FEATURE: (1) `approval.decide_intent {decision:"REJECT", decisionReason, runId}` passes the same fences + sources + human-review witness as APPROVE, then commits ONE multi-leg decision: core `rejectRun` on the run aggregate (findingsRef = sha256 over "moe-plan-rejection/1\n" + reason; successorRunId = a deterministic id derived from runId + commandId) AND a `PlanningRunCreated` REVISION event for the successor (goalRef = the run's goal) so the successor exists at version 1; the intent decision's committed result is {decision:"REJECT", decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId}. An empty/whitespace reason refuses APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED (layer DAEMON_PREREQUISITE) before any durable read; a run not in PLAN_REVIEW refuses with the existing sources/lifecycle code. (2) `currentPlanningRun(ledger, goal)` in a new module apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts (+.js): starts at goal.planningRunRef and follows lifecycle REJECTED -> successorRunId (bounded to 16 hops, cycle-safe, unreadable -> the original ref) returning {runId, hops, rejected: [{runId, successorRunId}]}. (3) activity-read.ts VERDICT_KINDS gains approval.decide_intent (and approval.decide) reading `result.decision`.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL store driven to PLAN_REVIEW (the fixtures approval-intent.test.ts already uses): `approval.decide_intent` REJECT with a reason and the human-review witness commits; the run aggregate reads lifecycle REJECTED with the successorRunId, the successor run aggregate reads DRAFT at version 1 with runKind REVISION and the same goalRef, and the intent decision result decodes to {decision, decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId} (exact keys).

Refusal arms with code + layer: empty/whitespace reason -> APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED before any store read (the existing 'refuses REJECT before looking up a durable run' arm at :1273 is re-aimed to this); REJECT without the human-review witness -> APPROVAL_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED (same as APPROVE); REJECT on a run already REJECTED or ACTIVATED -> the existing lifecycle/sources code; an MCP caller cannot reject (the MCP-excluded arm for approval.decide_intent unchanged, count line quoted). The APPROVE path is byte-identical: every existing APPROVE arm green unchanged.

`currentPlanningRun` test: original run -> REJECTED -> successor -> REJECTED -> successor resolves to the last one with hops 2 and both rejected ids; a cycle or an unreadable run resolves to the original ref without throwing; the bridge `.js` exists and the module is exported from apps/daemon/src/index.ts (index-surface EXPECTED_EXPORTS re-pinned by running it red first).
`/activity/read` entries for approval.decide_intent carry verdict APPROVE or REJECT read from the committed result (activity-read.test.ts arm per verdict); decisions of other kinds keep verdict null.
Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`; approval-intent.ts stays <= 250 lines (`wc -l` quoted) - the reject commit lives in approval-intent-rejection.ts.
taskRails: HUMAN GATE: REJECT rides the operator-only, MCP-excluded approval wire and requires the same HUMAN_APPROVED witness as APPROVE; a test pins that an MCP caller cannot reject. Never mint a rejection without the witness.
PURE DAEMON LEAF: no offer-ladder, compiler, wrapper, catalog-shape or UI change; if a step needs one, stop and say so (child 2/3).

Refusals assert code AND layer; mutate the surface to prove each arm red (global rail 1). <=250 physical lines per production source, hard stop 400; a new refusal code is added only where its roster pins are named in the plan.

implementationPlan.description: EXPORT THE CORE AUTHORITY. packages/core/src/index.ts: add `rejectRun` to the export block that already re-exports planning results (find the block exporting from ./planning/planning-results.js or add `export { rejectRun } from "./planning/planning-results.js";` beside `reducePlanningRun` at :51) - VALUE export, nothing else. packages/core/src/index-surface.test.ts: EXPECTED_EXPORTS is a sorted roster pinned at `toBe(255)` (:332) - run the test RED first to read the exact failure, insert `rejectRun` in sorted position with its kind, bump 255 -> 256 (re-measure: a peer may have moved it). Run from the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/index-surface.test.ts` - green, count line quoted. Also confirm the daemon can now import it: `grep -n "rejectRun" packages/core/src/index.ts` and a one-line typecheck probe inside apps/daemon (`import { rejectRun } from "@moe/core"` in a scratch file, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`, then delete the probe in the same command - global dependency-edge rail).

REJECTION TESTS FIRST (red) in apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.test.ts, reusing its harness: `reviewableStore()` (:103, driveThrough to approval.decide = a sealed PLAN_REVIEW run), `reviewedDispatch(store, commandId, intent)` (:156-170, carries humanReviewWitness(OPERATOR, commandId)), `INTENT` (:119), `refusalOf`, `readDurableLedger`, `replayAggregateId/replayRef`. (a) RE-AIM :1273-1280 'refuses REJECT before looking up a durable run' -> 'commits a REJECT with a reason: the run is rejected and a REVISION successor exists': dispatch {...INTENT, decision:"REJECT", decisionReason:"the plan skips the auth screen"} -> outcome ok; then read the store: the run aggregate's last event kind is PlanningRunRejected with `findingsRef` = sha256hex("moe-plan-rejection/1\n" + reason + "\n") and a `successorRunId`; the run state lifecycle is REJECTED; `store.readEvents(successorRunId)` holds exactly one PlanningRunCreated with runKind "REVISION", goalRef equal to the run's goalRef, version 1; the intent decision's result bytes decode to exactly {decision:"REJECT", decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId} (Object.keys sorted equality); `readDurableLedger(...).decisionCount` moved by exactly 1 (one multi-leg decision). (b) RE-AIM the table row at :1565-1567 'rejected intent' -> 'rejected intent without a reason' expecting APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED at layer DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT (same layer as the SHAPE_INVALID row at :1560); add a whitespace-only reason row with the same code; both assert decisionCount 0 (refused before any read). (c) REJECT with no human-review witness (the harness's `humanReview: undefined` override, :132/:147) -> APPROVAL_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED / APPROVAL_POLICY exactly like APPROVE's arm. (d) REJECT on a run already REJECTED (dispatch twice with different commandIds) -> the code `readApprovalIntentSources` answers for a non-PLAN_REVIEW lifecycle (read it from approval-intent-sources.ts:103-146 and assert code + layer literally). (e) REPLAY: the same commandId dispatched twice -> the second answer is the replay (disposition REPLAYED), decisionCount unchanged, no second successor aggregate. (f) RESOLVER arms: after (a), `currentPlanningRun(store, RUN_ID)` -> {runId: successor, hops: 1, rejected: [{runId: RUN_ID, successorRunId}]}; after rejecting the successor too (drive the successor to PLAN_REVIEW is NOT possible in this harness - instead write a second PlanningRunRejected on the successor through core `rejectRun` + `commitAcceptedLegs` inside the test, or accept hops 1 and add a pure-fold unit arm over hand-built event lists for hops 2, a cycle, and an unreadable event -> original ref, no throw). Run the file from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/planning/approval-intent.test.ts` - RED on the new/re-aimed arms only; quote them.

IMPLEMENT THE REJECTION COMMIT (green). NEW apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent-rejection.ts (<=250 lines) + bridge apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent-rejection.js (`export * from "./approval-intent-rejection.ts";`). Export `APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED = "APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED" as const`, `rejectionFindingsRef(reason)` (sha256hex over "moe-plan-rejection/1
" + reason + "
"), `successorRunIdFor(runId, commandId)` ("run-" + sha256hex(runId + "
" + commandId).slice(0, 24) - deterministic so a replay derives the same id), and `commitIntentRejection(store, ledger, command: IntentActivationCommand, input: { intent, humanReview, sources: ApprovalIntentSources, sourceFences })`: (1) run state = the PlanningRunState decoded from `sources.runRecord` (approval-intent-sources.ts:43; use the same decode the sources module uses - import its helper or `snapshotPlanningRunContractState` from @moe/core if exported, never a hand-written shape); (2) `const rejected = rejectRun(state, command.commandId, findingsRef, successorRunId)` from @moe/core (step 1) - not ok -> refuse with the core error via `refuseFromCore(kind, error)` (bootstrap-ledger.ts:129); (3) `const created = reducePlanningRun(undefined, { commandId: command.commandId + "-successor", goalRef: sources.goalRef, kind: "planning.create_draft", runId: successorRunId, runKind: "REVISION" })` - not ok -> refuseFromCore; (4) ONE decision through `commitAcceptedLegs(store, intentCommandRequest(command), { aggregateId: intent.runId, eventPayload: rejected.events, eventType: "PlanningRunRejected", expectedVersion: input.sourceFences.planningRunVersion, result: { decision: "REJECT", decisionReason: reason, findingsRef, runId: intent.runId, successorRunId } }, [{ aggregateId: successorRunId, eventPayload: created.events, eventType: "PlanningRunCreated", expectedVersion: 0 }])` - read `ExpectedVersionDecisionLeg`'s exact shape at bootstrap-ledger.ts:222-240 and match it; `intentCommandRequest` is private in approval-intent-activation.ts:181 - export it (same file, name unchanged) rather than duplicating the request shape. In apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts (244 lines - must not exceed 250 after this; move nothing else): replace :196-198 with `if (intent.decision === "REJECT" && (typeof intent.decisionReason !== "string" || intent.decisionReason.trim() === "")) return refuse(null, APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED, "DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT");` (before the fences, like today's early refusal), keep every check from :200-231 shared, and at :233-243 branch: `if (intent.decision === "REJECT") return commitIntentRejection(input.store, ledger, command, { humanReview: witness, intent, sources, sourceFences });` before `assembleActivationInput`. Do NOT touch the APPROVE path bytes. Re-run the test file: green, count line quoted; `wc -l` of approval-intent.ts and approval-intent-rejection.ts quoted.

RESOLVER. NEW apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts (<=250 lines) + bridge .js. Export `currentPlanningRun(store: SqliteEventStore, planningRunRef: string): CurrentPlanningRun` with `CurrentPlanningRun = Readonly<{ runId: string; hops: number; rejected: readonly Readonly<{ runId: string; successorRunId: string }>[]; unreadable: boolean }>` and a pure `foldCurrentRun(readEvents: (runId) => readonly StoredEvent[] | null, planningRunRef)` the store variant delegates to (the pure fold is what the hops-2 / cycle / unreadable arms drive). Rule: start at planningRunRef; read the aggregate's events; if the LAST event whose payload decodes (decodeBoundedJsonBytes) has kind "PlanningRunRejected" and a string successorRunId, hop; stop at 16 hops or on a repeated id (cycle) or an undecodable payload -> return the last GOOD id with unreadable:true; otherwise the current id with unreadable:false. Never throw: a throwing `readEvents` yields the original ref with unreadable:true. Frozen result. Import it relatively (no daemon root export - comment on this row). Re-run approval-intent.test.ts (the resolver arms from step 2f) green, count line quoted.

VERIFICATION GATE + DRILL. From the repo root: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (quote `Test Files N passed` + `Tests N passed`), `pnpm typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo), `pnpm test` (root lane - packages/core pin; quote its count line). Roster checks quoted: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/mcp-tool-allowlist.test.ts` from apps/daemon (approval.decide_intent stays MCP-excluded - unchanged pins); every existing APPROVE arm in approval-intent.test.ts green unchanged (`git diff -U0 -- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.test.ts` shows only the two re-aimed arms + the added arms - quote the hunk headers). DRILL (global rail 1) - new files are untracked until the completion commit: back them up to %TEMP%\moe-drill-<workerId>\ with SHA256 first; tracked files restore-proven with `git diff --exit-code -- <file>`. One mutation at a time, focused run, proven restore in a SEPARATE command: (1) accept an empty reason -> arm 2b red; (2) skip the witness check for REJECT -> arm 2c red; (3) commit the rejection leg WITHOUT the successor leg -> arm 2a red (successor events absent) and the resolver arm red; (4) derive successorRunId from Date.now() -> the replay arm 2e red (second successor) ; (5) resolver follows a non-REJECTED last event -> the cycle/unreadable arm red. Record the five red lines + restore proofs in the step note (under 4500 chars).

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW + COMPLETE. Load the adversarial-self-review skill: a reason of 100 KB - the intent payload is bounded by the envelope limits already (state which limit refuses it, or bound the reason to 4096 chars with APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED? no - add a distinct message on SHAPE_INVALID if the existing bounded-JSON limit does not catch it and test it); a reason containing the mission markers `<<<OPERATOR INSTRUCTIONS` - the daemon stores it verbatim (child 2 fences it at mission time; note it in the completion summary); two operators rejecting the same run concurrently - the run-version fence (expectedVersion = sourceFences.planningRunVersion) makes the second an EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT (assert once with a stale expectedVersion); the successor leg's expectedVersion 0 collides only if the deterministic id already exists (replay case, covered). Fix what you find, re-run the focused files, then `moe.complete_task` with verification = `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and its fresh count line; completionSummary names the core root export (+1 pin), the rejection decision result keys, `successorRunIdFor`'s derivation, the resolver signature and the five re-anchors recorded in comment on this row; then `moe.add_comment` on child 2 (task-957bccf162b446f3a4db46b56e8e8f3a) confirming the landed symbols and file paths. Report every touched path in complete_step.modifiedFiles; never stage scripts/up.ps1, scripts/watch.ps1 or .moe/messages/*.

comments.content:
PLAN-TIME RE-ANCHORS (architect-16a01670, measured at main 68eb1c5d) - grade these, not the original wording:
1) `rejectRun` is NOT exported from @moe/core's root (packages/core/src/index.ts exports reducePlanningRun only; root pin packages/core/src/index-surface.test.ts:332 EXPECTED_EXPORTS = 255) and the daemon may not deep-import (no tsconfig paths, TS6059). This row exports `rejectRun` from the core root (+1 on the pin) - that is the only honest path; reimplementing the transition in the daemon is forbidden authority.
2) `successorRunId` is carried on the PlanningRunRejected EVENT (planning-results.ts:141-145), not on the run STATE, so the resolver signature is `currentPlanningRun(store, planningRunRef)` reading the run aggregate's events per hop (bounded 16, cycle-safe). It is NOT exported from apps/daemon/src/index.ts (DoD 3 amended: in-package consumers import it relatively; no index-surface pin bump) and its arms live in approval-intent.test.ts (the harness that can produce a real rejection) - no separate test file.
3) APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED refuses at layer DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT (the intent-shape layer that APPROVAL_INTENT_SHAPE_INVALID uses, approval-intent.test.ts:1560), not DAEMON_PREREQUISITE - it is a payload-shape rule answered before any store read.
4) The activity `verdict` for approval kinds (DoD 4) MOVES TO CHILD 2 (task-957bccf1) to keep this row within the 10-file cap; child 2's comment records it. This row's DoD 4 is void here.
5) The successor is minted through core's own `reducePlanningRun(undefined, {kind:"planning.create_draft", runKind:"REVISION", goalRef, runId: successorRunId, commandId})` (planning-run-reducer.ts:186-197, :95-108), committed as the second leg of `commitAcceptedLegs` (bootstrap-ledger.ts:222-240) in the SAME decision as the rejection leg.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 9 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Reimplement the REJECTED transition in the daemon - REJECTED: authority reimplemented outside core (rail). (2) Deep-import rejectRun from packages/core/src - REJECTED: no tsconfig paths / project references (TS6059); the honest path is a root export (+1 on core's EXPECTED_EXPORTS pin). (3) Create the successor by hand-building a PlanningRunCreated event - REJECTED: core's `reducePlanningRun(undefined, planning.create_draft REVISION)` is the writer of record (planning-run-reducer.ts:186-197, :95-108); the daemon only commits its events. (4) Two separate decisions (reject, then create successor) - REJECTED: a crash between them leaves a REJECTED run with no successor; `commitAcceptedLegs` (bootstrap-ledger.ts:222-240) fences both aggregates in one decision. (5) A time-based successor id - REJECTED: replay must derive the same id; sha256(runId, commandId) does. (6) A separate resolver test file and a daemon root export - REJECTED to stay within the 10-file cap; arms live in approval-intent.test.ts (the only harness that produces a real rejection) and consumers import relatively. (7) The activity verdict - MOVED to child 2 for the same cap reason.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Measured 2026-09-04 at main 68eb1c5d: approval-intent.ts:91 DECISIONS, :116-137 intent shape, :196-198 non-APPROVE refusal (BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID before any read), :200-243 the shared checks (source fences :202-207 with expectedVersion == planningRunVersion; readApprovalIntentSources :212 -> {goalRef, runRecord, ...} at approval-intent-sources.ts:33-59, :103-146; human witness :218-231; assemble + commitIntentActivation :237-243); approval-intent-activation.ts: IntentActivationCommand :42-51, intentCommandRequest :181-188 (private), commitIntentActivation :218-229 (replayOf then activateInitialGraphWithApprovalReplay). Core: rejectRun(state, commandId, findingsRef, successorRunId) planning-results.ts:132-146 (event {commandId, findingsRef, kind:"PlanningRunRejected", successorRunId, version}; state lifecycle REJECTED; the successorRunId is on the EVENT only); reducePlanningRun(undefined, create_draft) planning-run-reducer.ts:186-197 -> create :95-108 (PlanningRunCreated {commandId, goalRef, kind, runId, runKind, version:1}); core root exports reducePlanningRun (index.ts:51) and the PlanningRunRejected types (:96-98) but NOT rejectRun; core root pin index-surface.test.ts:332 = 255. Daemon commit helpers: bootstrap-ledger.ts commitAccepted :193, commitAcceptedLegs :222-240 (extraLegs: ExpectedVersionDecisionLeg[]), refuseFromCore :129. Test harness: approval-intent.test.ts reviewableStore :103 (driveThrough to approval.decide), INTENT :119, dispatch overrides :132-147 (humanReview), reviewedDispatch :156-170, REJECT arms :1273-1280 and :1565-1567, SHAPE_INVALID row :1558-1561 at layer DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT.
planningNotes.risks: (a) The core pin (255) and the daemon's approval-intent.ts line count (244) are both at the edge - re-measure before editing; approval-intent.ts must stay <= 250 (the branch is ~6 lines; if it does not fit, move the early reason check into the rejection module as an exported predicate). (b) `sources.runRecord` is a JsonValue - decode it with the same helper the sources module uses; never hand-shape a PlanningRunState. (c) The successor's commandId must differ from the rejection's (same decision key otherwise) - `<commandId>-successor`. (d) A REJECT on a run whose graph was already activated must be refused by the sources' lifecycle check, not by rejectRun - assert the sources code. (e) The scheduler package-boundary scan tokenizes every source: keep apostrophes out of TS comments. (f) Peer dirt (scripts/up.ps1, scripts/watch.ps1, .moe/messages/*) never staged; new files untracked until the completion commit - drill restores proven by SHA256.
